title: High Pressure Compressor (HPC) Static Pressure Loss & Tip Clearance Degradation

telemetry_indicators.sensor_11: Static pressure at HPC outlet drops below 47.0 psia (nominal 47.2 - 47.6 psia)
telemetry_indicators.sensor_3: Total pressure at HPC outlet drops under 1580.0 psia
telemetry_indicators.sensor_7: Total pressure at HPC outlet shows negative trend slope

root_causes: Axial compressor blade tip rub and aerodynamic erosion causing excessive clearance
Fouling of stator vanes from airborne particulates and particulate ingestion
Variable Stator Vane (VSV) actuator mechanical hysteresis
dispatch_protocol: Conditional Ground Hold if failure probability exceeds 65%. Maximum 25 flight cycles permitted.
inspection_procedure: Step 1: Perform 4-stage borescope inspection through port S3 and S4 to inspect HPC rotor blades for leading-edge pitting.
Step 2: Measure rotor blade-to-casing tip clearance using optical feeler gauge. Threshold limit: 0.045 inches.
Step 3: Execute full compressor core wash using demineralized solvent cleaner (MIL-PRF-85704 Type II).
Step 4: Verify VSV feedback rig pins alignment within +/- 0.5 degrees tolerance.

replacement_parts.part_name: VSV Feedback Actuator Rig Pin Kit

safety_advisories: Do not exceed ground idle tests during wash cycle. Ensure bleed air valves are isolated.
